_help: Carrier route lines. Fields: {destination} {carrier} {system} {squadron}. Plotting uses the normal route lines afterwards.
CarrierPlotting: Plotting a route to the {carrier} in {destination}. One moment.
Heading for the {carrier}. Working out the route to {destination}.
Let me find the way to the {carrier} in {destination}.
Route to the {carrier}, {destination}. Give me a few seconds.
Carrier route coming up. {destination} is where she's parked.
CarrierPlotting_Friendly: Home sweet carrier. Plotting to {destination} now.
Right, taking you back to the {carrier} in {destination}.
CarrierPlotting_Close: Back to the {carrier}, and a proper rest. Plotting to {destination}.
Let's get you home, love. Route to {destination} coming up.
CarrierPlotting_Sarcastic: Off to {destination} we go, because apparently the {carrier} won't come to us.
CarrierHere: We're already in {system}, Commander. The {carrier} should be right here.
Look around. The {carrier} is in this very system, {system}.
No route needed. We're in {system} already.
CarrierHere_Sarcastic: We are in {system}. The {carrier} is in {system}. I'll let you work out the rest.
CarrierFleetUnknown: I don't know where your fleet carrier is. Dock at it once, or type the system on the Bookmarks page, or say: save this system as my carrier.
No idea where your carrier is yet. Visit it, or save its system as your carrier and I'll remember.
I haven't seen your fleet carrier this session. Put its system in the Fleet carrier bookmark and ask me again.
CarrierFleetUnknown_Sarcastic: You've lost a carrier. That's quite a feat. Tell me which system it's in: save this system as my carrier.
CarrierSquadUnknown: I know you're in {squadron}, but I don't know where the squad carrier is. Go to it and say: save this system as the squad carrier.
No squad carrier saved for {squadron}. Stand in its system and tell me to save it, or type it on the Bookmarks page.
Where is the {squadron} carrier? I can't tell. Save its system as the squad carrier and I'll plot there.
CarrierNoSquad: I don't have a squad carrier saved, and I don't think you're in a squadron. If you are, save the carrier's system as the squad carrier.
No squad carrier that I know of. If you have one, stand in its system and say: save this system as the squad carrier.
I can't find a squadron for you. If there is a squad carrier, tell me where with: save this system as the squad carrier.
CarrierNoSquad_Sarcastic: A squad carrier needs a squad. I haven't seen one. Save its system if you do have one.
